question: Should exec/process/node-host tool results redact secret-shaped output by default before the agent sees it, even though existing workflows may no longer receive byte-exact command output?
rationale: The patch fixes a real sensitive-output exposure, but default redaction versus an explicit raw-output reveal path is a security-boundary and product-contract decision rather than a mechanical code review call.

options.title: Merge default redaction
options.body: Accept redaction as the default agent-visible contract and handle any explicit raw-output reveal path as a separate security-reviewed feature.

options.title: Require reveal control first
options.body: Keep the PR open until it adds and proves an explicit, auditable way to request raw output when redaction is unacceptable.

options.title: Reject default redaction
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if maintainers decide byte-exact exec/process output must remain the default contract.

recommendation.title: Merge default redaction
recommendation.body: Accept redaction as the default agent-visible contract and handle any explicit raw-output reveal path as a separate security-reviewed feature.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent exec/process history signal and was already asked in the PR discussion for this decision.
